phases.title: method bodies as functions defined at build (.ckk format bump)
phases.notes: kk._body_fn FN BODY defines __kkm.OWNER.METHOD (own methods of the DEFINING class; none for an inherited copy) and __kkc.CLASS (constructor) once, when the body is stored: kk._build_class_runtime, defineMethod, Pascal build (constructor inherited from the parent), kk._body_fns_sync (class without bind template = pre-U2b cache). The function's PROLOGUE is the K2 bind (`local -n +x` from ${CLASS}_class_binds) + the set -a restore, so binds and body share one scope: local/declare/unset of a bound name keep the exact pre-K1 meaning (probe old vs new identical on Git-bash 5.3.15, MSYS2 5.3.9, Cygwin 5.2.21). Definition wrapped in `if :; then ... fi` (parsed whole before anything runs): a body that does not parse falls back to a function that evals the stored text per call (pre-K1 behaviour). kk._invoke / kk._run_frame_body receive a function NAME; kk._exec tests the body variable's set-ness; kk._call/kk._parent run kk._body_none when the variable was unset after the cache resolved it (as the empty eval before). Text variables kept (existence, subclass copies, decl tables, kcl thttpserver tests). kk._invoke_constructor (parent-constructor chaining) still evals the text. A rebuild redefines a function whose method became inherited with the inherited text (mirrors the variable). __kkm/__kkc declared as kklass namespaces (kk._ns_declare + taken table): kcl census. .ckk format 5 -> 6 (compiler dumps __kkm.CLASS.* and __kkc.CLASS). D2: FUNCNAME[0] in a body = __kkm.OWNER.METHOD, [1] = kk._run_frame_body; LINENO/error-line prefixes change; a set -T RETURN trap fires once more. Tests: 150 K1.1-K1.15, 147 A3-A6 updated, 150 K2.11 format-agnostic. Build time unchanged (fresh kk.uses dateutils 373/379 ms, math 240/237, thttpserver 294/314, tstringlist 125/123, k2/cur best of 3); 234 body functions for 9 common units
